settings.agree: I understand, and this office may send files to the provider.

settings.provider_body: Pick one and paste its key. Keys are kept locked on this computer and never shown again.
settings.model_body: Automatic picks the provider's current best general model from its own list, and falls back to the next one when it is busy.

ask.missing: What is missing from this file?
ask.decide: What should I decide, and why?
ask.how_stage: How do the case stages work?
ask.limits: Which time limits apply in this country?

dock.file_intro: Ask about this file. Assist has read it, with the law the office holds and how similar cases were handled here.
dock.office_intro: Ask about your work, the stages of a case, or the law of this country. Open a file to ask about it.
dock.footer: Drafts, not decisions. Check before you rely on them.

provider.gemini: Google's models. A free key works for trying it out.
provider.openrouter: One key, hundreds of models; it picks one for you.
provider.anthropic: Claude, from Anthropic. Strong at long legal reading.
provider.other: A model on this computer (Ollama) or a government server.

court.filed_what_placeholder: e.g. Charge sheet, Summary of the case
court.no_hearings: No hearing yet. Add the first date when the court gives it.
court.outcome_placeholder: What happened (adjourned to, plea taken, ruling...)

import.title: Import paper into this file
import.lead_assist: Add a scanned PDF or photos of the pages. Assist reads them, splits them into documents and puts each one in its place in the file. You check it after.
import.lead_plain: Add a scanned PDF or photos of the pages. Each goes into the file as one document for you to sort. Turn on Assist in Settings to have them read and arranged for you.
import.drop: Drop scans here, or choose them
import.kinds: PDF, JPG, PNG or phone photos. Several at once is fine.
import.reading_body: Handwriting and stamps included. A thick file can take a minute or two.
import.done_body: Check where each one went, move any that are wrong, then confirm.
import.failed: The scans could not be read
import.failed_body: The scans you added are kept with the file under Details. You can try again, or sort them by hand.
import.found_body: Add the people and the proposed charge to the file, so its cover and next step fill in. Untick anything that is wrong.

index.check_body: Open any document to read it or move it to another section. Confirm when the file is in order.
index.empty_body: Import the police file as scans or photos, or type a document straight in: a statement taken down, a minute, a note of a call.
index.order_provisional: The order of sections is provisional for this country.
index.placed_by_assist: Placed by Assist, not yet checked
index.text_placeholder: Type or paste what the document says
index.title: Title

handover.email_body: Please find attached the case file: {title}.
handover.email_attach: The file is saved. Attach it to the email that opened.
handover.failed: The case file could not be made

pipe.receive_body: {documents} documents in the file ({unchecked} not yet checked), {people} people and {charges} proposed charges recorded.
pipe.prepare_no_decision: No decision is recorded yet: decide first.
pipe.prepare_nothing: The decision ({decision}) needs no document of its own. Accept to go on to the hand-over.
pipe.ready_to_conclude: Assist thinks nothing more is expected: accepting moves the file to Concluded.
pipe.diy_receive: Import the paper or type the documents in, on
pipe.accepted: Accepted. The file is now at: {stage}
pipe.from_record: From what the file already holds
pipe.proposed_by: Prepared by Assist ({model}), {date}. Read it, change what you need, then accept.
pipe.propose_failed: Assist could not prepare this stage
pipe.assist_off: Assist is off: do this stage yourself below, or turn Assist on in Settings.

export.scan_missing: The scan for this document could not be put in the file. Its text as read:

viewer.cannot_show: This document cannot be shown here.

laws.title: Law library
laws.body: The texts Assist may quote for {country}, each with the date it is correct at. Assist says so when the text it needs is not here.
laws.api_body: Keeps the country's statutes current, with their dates. The office needs its own token from laws.africa.
laws.sync_failed: The laws could not be updated

clock.title: Legal time limits
clock.none: No arrest or detention recorded on this file, so no legal clock is running.
clock.overdue: Limit passed {when} ({date}). Nothing recorded ends it.
clock.secondary: (from secondary sources: confirm in the text)

seal.hint: A PNG or JPEG under 400 KB, on a white or clear background. It is copied onto each document when it is issued.
seal.signature_body: Put on documents you issue, above your name.
seal.stamp_body: The office stamp, put on every document issued here.
seal.too_big: The image is larger than 400 KB.
seal.wrong_type: Use a PNG or JPEG image.
seal.pad_hint: Sign with a pen, a finger or the mouse

verify.genuine: Genuine: {title}, {file}, issued by {author} on {date}. The record has not changed since.
verify.lead: Type the reference and the code printed beside the QR on a paper document to confirm it was issued here and has not been altered.
verify.mismatch: A document with this reference exists, but the code does not match or the record was altered. Treat the paper as not genuine.
verify.not_found: No document with this reference was issued here.
verify.title: Verify a document
verify.paper_genuine: Genuine. This paper was printed by {by} on {date}. Compare it word for word with the wording below.
verify.paper_hint: A paper printed from the app carries only a code: type it alone to check it.

paper.print_hint: Choose "Save as PDF" in the print window to keep a PDF.
paper.verify_line: Check this paper with its code
paper.changed: Changed since it was last printed
paper.failed: The paper could not be prepared

binder.received: As received from Police. Not changed by this office.
binder.empty: No papers yet. Add what Police sent, or import the papers.

statement.name: Name
statement.no_text: The wording of this statement is in the attached scan.

title.accused: Statement of accused under charge and caution

paper.print_hint_windows: To keep a PDF, choose "Microsoft Print to PDF" as the printer.
paper.latest: This is the latest version of this paper.
paper.no_history: This paper has not left the office yet. Each time it is printed or saved, the version is kept here.
paper.no_related: No other papers on this file belong with this one.
paper.no_citations: No law or other paper is named in this paper.

decision.title: Record of decision
decision.no_reasons: No reasons were written for this decision.

paper.write_hint: Write on the paper with a pen, a finger or the mouse. It is kept with this office's copy and printed with it.

stations.add_lead: A station can send files here once it accepts this office's invitation and you have checked its code together.
stations.step1: 1. Name the station and make its invitation.
stations.step2: 2. Give the invitation file to the station: e-mail, a stick, any way.
stations.step3: 3. Open the station's reply here, then check its code with them by phone.
stations.send_it: Give the saved file to the station before {date}. When they reply, open their reply on this page.
stations.check_code: Call the station and read this code to each other. Connect only if it is the same.
stations.type_code: Type the code the station reads to you

line.invited: Invited · waiting for their reply until {date}
line.check: Replied · check their code to connect

stations.subtitle: The stations that can send files to this office.
stations.empty: No station is connected yet. Add the stations this office works with.

workload.subtitle: What is on this office's desk now. How things went over time is in Statistics.

statistics.subtitle: How the office's work went over a period, counted from the record.

recent.subtitle: Files and documents opened lately on this computer.
recent.empty: Nothing opened yet. Files and documents you open will be here.

people.subtitle: Accused, complainants and witnesses across the files.
